Triple Fusion The movement and flexibility of your foot involves three joints - the subtalar, the calcaneocuboid and the talo-navicular joints. Patients with painful arthritis or a deformity in these joints may benefit from triple fusion.

Tummy tuck (Abdominoplasty) A tummy tuck (also known as an abdominoplasty) is a popular cosmetic surgery that creates a flatter, firmer abdomen by removing excess skin and fat while tightening weakened muscles, especially after pregnancy or major weight loss.
Turbinectomy Find out how a turbinectomy treats a permanently blocked nose, what happens during surgery, and what to expect for recovery and risks.

Umbilical hernia surgery A bulge or swelling near your belly button can be uncomfortable and worrying – especially if it gets in the way of lifting, exercising or simply moving comfortably. You may want to consider umbilical hernia surgery. Our expert surgeons at Nuffield Health can help fix the underlying weakness and help you get back to daily life with confidence.
Uterine Artery Embolisation Uterine Artery Embolisation (UAE) is a minimally invasive procedure to treat uterine fibroids (non-cancerous growths in the uterus).
Vaginal Prolapse Surgery When the muscles and ligaments in your vagina become weak the organs (including your bladder, bowel or uterus) they support may push forward or prolapse.
Vaginoplasty A vaginoplasty is a surgery carried out to create an aesthetic and functional neo-vagina.
Varicocele embolisation

Varicose vein stripping If your varicose veins are causing aching, swelling or discomfort, varicose vein stripping at Nuffield Health may help. It's a surgical procedure to remove enlarged, twisted veins from your leg through small incisions in your groin or behind your knee.

Vasectomy or male sterilisation A vasectomy is a surgical procedure to stop the transfer of sperm during ejaculation. It is a simple, reliable method of contraception. In some cases it is reversible, but you should really think of it as a permanent option.
Vasectomy reversal A vasectomy is meant to be a permanent form of male contraception. If your circumstances change, this procedure can undo your vasectomy.
VASER Liposuction VASER liposuction uses ultrasound waves to break up and liquefy fat cells, making them easier to extract.
VenaSeal™Closure Considering VenaSeal for varicose veins? Find out how this glue-based vein treatment works, its benefits versus heat-based options, and recovery.
Venesection Find out what a venesection involves, which conditions it treats, and what to expect before, during and after your appointment.

Vertebroplasty If you’ve been told you have a spinal compression fracture, you may be wondering what vertebroplasty actually involves. It’s a minimally invasive way to stabilise the collapsed bone and help reduce pain but your consultant will decide whether it’s the right option based on your scans and symptoms.

Video-assisted anal fistula surgery treatment (VAAFT) An anal fistula is a small tunnel that forms between the end of the bowel and the skin near the anus, where faeces exit the body. Typically, anal fistulas develop because of an infection near the anus that leads to the accumulation of pus (abscess) in the surrounding tissue. As the pus drains away, it can leave a small channel or tunnel behind. Anal fistulas can cause discomfort, skin irritation, unpleasant discharge, and usually do not heal spontaneously.
Video-assisted thoracoscopic surgery (VATS) Considering VATS for a lung or chest condition? Find out what this keyhole chest surgery involves, its benefits, and how recovery typically goes.

Visual field test A visual field test checks how much you can see around what you're looking at, known as your field of vision. Your Nuffield Health eye specialist may recommend one if you have a family history of glaucoma, symptoms such as blind spots or unexplained headaches, or a condition like diabetes that can affect your eyes.

Vitrectomy A vitrectomy is surgery to remove the vitreous humour, the clear jelly-like substance that fills your eye, so your consultant can repair problems affecting your retina and restore your vision. Our Nuffield Health eye specialists will explain whether a vitrectomy is right for you and guide you from diagnosis through to recovery.
Vulval lesion excision Been told you need a vulval lesion excision? Find out what the operation involves, how healing feels, and the risks and recovery timeline to expect.
Vulvoplasty A vulvoplasty creates all the parts of a vagina except for the vaginal canal. In choosing a cosmetic procedure you will not be able to have penetrative sex.

Watery eye treatment Watery eyes (epiphora) can be caused by a range of conditions, including blocked tear ducts and tear drainage problems. At Nuffield Health, our consultant ophthalmologists provide specialist assessment and personalised watery eye treatment, from conservative therapies through to advanced lacrimal (tear duct) surgery.

Weight loss surgery There are several surgical procedures that can help you to lose weight and maintain weight loss. These include gastric band, gastric bypass, gastric balloon and sleeve gastrectomy.
Weight Management in Diabetes Managing your weight with diabetes? Find out the real benefits, the different approaches available, and how to get started safely and realistically.
Xanthelasma removal surgery Xanthelasma removal surgery is a cosmetic eyelid procedure is used to remove cholesterol-filled skin lesions called Xanthelasma that appear around the eyelids.

YAG laser capsulotomy A YAG laser capsulotomy is a procedure to treat 'after-cataract,' a common condition where the membrane behind your lens implant becomes hazy after an initial cataract surgery. This quick and painless laser treatment creates a small, clear window in the cloudy membrane.
